name: pixelcoop-farm
features: Start screen picks a starting environment for the chicken farm.
Shop places chickens, feed, fence, coop, water source, pipe, waterer, well, worms, dust, perch and scratch, and erase removes them.
Water flows through pipes and chickens eat, drink and use coops.
Egg or meat farm mode and selling chickens earn money.
Pause, cycle speed, zoom, whole map and reset map work.
